description: Lines the Investigation Team speaks in Vincent's nightmares. Text is written for this crossover; portraits and the voice bark that plays with each line are the cast's real P4G assets from the player's install (bark_index into the speaker's voice_source bank, null = no bark).

rows.speaker: yu
rows.text: Hey. Vincent, right? You're not just dreaming. This is the other side of the TV.

rows.speaker: yu
rows.text: Something in here wants you climbing. We've dealt with worse. Take this.

rows.speaker: yu
rows.text: When the tower gets ahead of you, call Izanagi. Sukunda slows everything down for a few seconds.

rows.speaker: teddie
rows.text: Sensei's right! Watch your step, beary carefully, okay? The Team's waiting at the top!

rows.speaker: yosuke
rows.text: Dude... sheep? Talking sheep? Okay, I hang out with a talking bear, so I can't judge.

rows.speaker: yosuke
rows.text: Here. Jiraiya's Garu can yank a block out three times before you blink. Use it when you're boxed in.

rows.speaker: chie
rows.text: Tip from someone who's kicked a lot of things: don't climb straight up. Pull blocks out to the sides and make stairs.

rows.speaker: chie
rows.text: And whatever's waiting at the top of the next one sounds a LOT like Yosuke. Just saying.

rows.speaker: teddie
rows.text: I can smell a Shadow up there! It's grrr-umpy and it's someone we know. Don't let it catch you!

rows.speaker: shadow_yosuke
rows.text: I am a shadow... the true self.
rows._notes: The Shadow-self line from P4G; find its clip in the voice bank.

rows.speaker: shadow_yosuke
rows.text: Climbing away from your problems? Heh. Who does that remind you of?

rows.speaker: shadow_yosuke
rows.text: This tower, this town, it's all so BORING. Let it all fall down!

rows.speaker: yosuke
rows.text: ...Yeah. That's me too. Thanks for climbing through it, man.
